summary: Comprehensive testing of Phase 1 Multi-Layer Authentication features. All 26 backend tests passed. Frontend UI flows verified for registration, multi-stage login, Settings modal with L3/Hardcore options, disclaimer popup, and legal modals.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy user test@toppass5.com was created before L3 feature - shows 'Could not load Layer 3 data' error when viewing L3 passwords. This is expected behavior for legacy users without L3 passwords.
The L3 passwords are stored encrypted with Fernet. If VAULT_KEY changes, existing L3 passwords become unreadable.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_* users created during backend tests (TEST_reg_*, TEST_login_*, TEST_l3mgmt_*, TEST_hardcore_*, TEST_disclaimer_*, TEST_authme_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Multi-Layer Auth fully tested. Key flows: (1) Registration requires birthday (double confirm), returns 20 L3 passwords + 12-word phrase. (2) Login Stage 1 returns stage='birthday' for users with birthday. (3) Birthday verification advances to L3 quiz (if enabled) or grants access. (4) L3 quiz shows 3 random positions, correct answers grant full access. (5) Disclaimer popup on first login. (6) Settings modal has L3 toggle (requires quiz to enable), View/Regenerate passwords, Hardcore Mode settings. (7) Legacy users without birthday login directly. Test credentials: test@toppass5.com / Test1234! (legacy, no birthday).
